motion.name: fast
motion.purpose: Hover and state transitions on buttons, nav, tab, rail glyphs.

motion.name: throw
motion.purpose: A committed swipe throws the ticket off-screen, then follows the link.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: An uncommitted drag returns to rest.

motion.name: tilt
motion.purpose: Maximum rotation, proportional to drag share of card width.

motion.name: drag-start
motion.purpose: Horizontal travel before a press becomes a drag.

motion.name: toward
motion.purpose: Travel before the target rail glyph lights (stage data-toward).

motion.name: commit
motion.value: 30% of card width, or flick > 0.5px/ms over >= 30px within 100ms

motion.name: resist
motion.purpose: Give when there is no neighbor in that direction.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: the card fades instead of translating and tilting.

motion.name: how-field
motion.value: cross-document view transition, names field-help / field-ask, 460ms var(--ease-out); group overflow clip, background in the field color, 18px radius from 960px; snapshots object-fit none, object-position left bottom
motion.purpose: The tapped home door grows into its story field and the other door shrinks into the docked strip; only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

motion.name: how-cut
motion.value: clip-path inset(0 0 0 100%) + translateX(32px) to rest, 420ms var(--ease-out); old step fades and moves 32px left, 220ms ease-in
motion.purpose: Each story step's content (how-step) wipes in from the right.

motion.name: how-back
motion.value: view transition type back: clip-path inset(0 100% 0 0) + translateX(-32px) in, old leaves 32px right
motion.purpose: Going back a step, or to the doors (step 0), reverses the cut; set by how.js on pagereveal.

motion.name: how-open
motion.value: view transition type open: incoming how-step delayed 220ms
motion.purpose: Opening a door or switching stories lets the field land before the words cut in.

motion.name: how-swipe
motion.purpose: Swipe or arrow keys follow the Back / Next links on story steps.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Tighter card right padding and tab gap.

breakpoints.purpose: Nav into top bar; 470px stage + 400px Chip in panel; post page two columns.

narrative.overview:
The app is a black frame around one person. The shell (top bar, bottom nav, feed stage, post page) is void black, and inside it a single ask fills the screen as a saturated color field with its title set huge in condensed uppercase. You move through people sideways: drag left for the next ask, drag right to go back, and the neighboring ask's color is already waiting underneath, so every move reads as a cut from one field to the next rather than a scroll. White is the only interface ink on the stage. The one money action, Chip in, is a white filled tab that travels with the person.

Away from the stage, the working pages (Gifts, Leaders, profile, forms, admin, legal) are quiet and dense. They follow the system color scheme: cool paper and white panels in light, near-black panels in dark. They share the same two typefaces, the same inverse filled button, and the same hairline language. Lists are hairline rows, progress is a single hairline meter, and states are a small shape plus a word. There are no shadows, glass, or glow, and no gradient except the scrim that keeps white text legible at the foot of a color field.

The system is built for a phone held in one hand. It works at 360px without horizontal scroll and works without JavaScript, because every gesture has a real link behind it. At 960px and wider, the nav moves up into the bar and the stage becomes a framed 470px column standing beside a 400px Chip in panel on void.
keyCharacteristics: Void-black shell that is always dark: top bar, bottom nav, feed stage, and post page.
One full-bleed color field per ask (Need or Want) under a bottom scrim, with white type only.
League Gothic uppercase for titles, set huge and tall. Public Sans for everything else.
Inverse filled primary (ink on light, white on dark), outlined secondary, and tomato only for errors and destructive acts.
Hairline meter, hairline rows, and Lucide 2px line icons.
Sideways gestures with a way back: left = next, right = back, each mirrored by a labeled rail button.

rules.name: The White Ink Rule
rules.body: On the stage and on any color field, white is the only interface ink: text, glyphs, the Chip in tab, and focus rings. Nothing colored sits on a colored field.

rules.name: The Tomato Is Trouble Rule
rules.body: The bad family appears only for errors, disputed gifts, and destructive actions. It is never decoration, never a category, and never the Chip in color.

rules.name: The Always-Void Stage Rule
rules.body: The shell and any page that carries an ask's field stay dark whatever the system setting. Ordinary pages follow `prefers-color-scheme`, and the stage forces the dark token set.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: League Gothic is only for titles and the wordmark, always uppercase. Every sentence, label, number, and control is Public Sans. Don't use a system face for display.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Every amount, count, rank, and badge number uses tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Scrim Only Rule
rules.body: The one gradient is the bottom scrim on a color field (transparent to 40% black over the lower half on cards, and over the lower 60% on the post hero). No other gradients, glass, glow, or box shadows.

dos: **Do** keep the top bar, bottom nav, feed stage, and post page void (#0a0a0a) in both color schemes, and let every other page follow `prefers-color-scheme`.
**Do** give each ask a full-bleed color field with the bottom scrim and white type, and check that any new category color holds white at 4.5:1 or better.
**Do** set titles in League Gothic uppercase and everything else in Public Sans, with tabular numerals for money and counts.
**Do** use the inverse filled button for the screen's main action, and outline everything else.
**Do** show progress only with the hairline meter, and lists only as hairline rows.
**Do** use Lucide line icons at a 2px stroke from the `_icons.html` sprite, always with a visible text label.
**Do** back every gesture with a labeled button and a real link, so the feed works without JavaScript and at 360px with no horizontal scroll.
**Do** say "gift" and "chip in" in interface copy.
**Do** label every demo piece of the app "Example" with the outlined tag, and make it mirror the real component and its real state exactly.
donts: **Don't** use tomato for anything but errors, disputed gifts, and destructive actions.
**Don't** add box shadows, glass, glow, or gradients other than the field scrim.
**Don't** put colored text or colored controls on a color field. It's white or nothing.
**Don't** turn state into pills or badges with fills. Use a shape and a word.
**Don't** add a second progress style (rings, segmented bars, or percentages as hero numbers).
**Don't** nest cards in panels or lay asks out as a card grid or vertical-scroll feed.
**Don't** say "donation" or "charity" anywhere in the interface.
**Don't** invent stats, counts, testimonials, or quotes on marketing surfaces. The proof is the real app pieces, labeled Example.
